Noah: Heads-up: planning a quick staged deploy at 21:45 UTC. Changes: api header routing switch, runtime kernel pin, console toggle. Need api/runtime/router/console sync. Rollback gates: errors >0.5% OR p99 increase >800ms for 3m.

Emilia: Copy. I'll pause console schema merges until we confirm router. Which runtime image?

Noah: Pin runtime to rtx-2.3.1-rc, rollback -> rtx-2.2.8. Header key X-RD-Kern, values kern-a vs kern-b. Order: wave1 api+runtime, wave2 router, wave3 console.

Chen: I can flip router. Flag name `hdr-kern-split`. Canary at 2%.

Noah: deploy-bot schedule waves accordingly.

deploy-bot: Scheduling:
- wave1: api+runtime @ 21:45 UTC (2%)
- wave2: router @ 21:55 UTC (2%)
- wave3: console @ 22:05 UTC (2%)
Commands:
```
/deploy create --service api --image api:release-2026-03-21 --wave 1
/deploy create --service runtime --image runtime:rtx-2.3.1-rc --wave 1
```

Ravi: I'll stand by on ops. Add artifact checksum to the runbook.

Emilia: Metric rename note: `api.request.router_version` -> `api.request.route_variant`. Pushing dashboard patch.

Chen: Staging smoke passed with header split config:
```
route_split:
  header: X-RD-Kern
  variants:
    kern-a: 98
    kern-b: 2
```

deploy-bot: Preflight checks PASS (artifacts, deps api->runtime, capacity ok).

deploy-bot: Wave1 started at 21:45 UTC id=wave-9001 target 2%.

deploy-bot: Wave1 results (21:50 UTC): errors 0.01%, p99 +0.03ms -> PASS.

deploy-bot: Wave2 started at 21:55 UTC router flag rotated for 2%.

deploy-bot: Wave2 results (22:01 UTC): routing stable, no config drift -> PASS.

deploy-bot: Wave3 started at 22:05 UTC console toggle enabled for 2%.

deploy-bot: Wave3 results (22:10 UTC): console canary fine, scheduled full rollout at 22:20 UTC.

Ravi: Ops will monitor for 20m post-rollout. If threshold breached runbook cmds: `/deploy rollback --service runtime --image runtime:rtx-2.2.8` and `/router revert --flag hdr-kern-split --to kern-a`.

Noah: Release notes draft: kernel pinning (rtx-2.3.1-rc), header-based gradual routing, console schema v5 behind toggle. PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/1450. Thanks team.
